title: Dữ liệu của tôi không hoạt động.
pronunciation: Du lieu cua toi khong hoat dong
summary: For showing that mobile data is on but maps, messages, or browser pages still will not load.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it with the cellular data screen, no-service bar, or failed app open.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the phone while you say it. The helper may check data balance, roaming, SIM setup, or coverage.

phrases.vietnamese: Dữ liệu của tôi không hoạt động.
phrases.pronunciation: Du lieu cua toi khong hoat dong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Dữ liệu của tôi means my data; không hoạt động means is not working.

breakdown.vietnamese: Dữ liệu của tôi không hoạt động.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi password and SIM-card cards help if the answer is to switch networks or check the SIM.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at phone shops, airport SIM desks, hotel desks, cafes, and anywhere you need help getting online.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Data problems are easier to diagnose with the settings screen open. Keep the phone unlocked until the next check is clear.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Move to battery, charger, charge-here, data-top-up, eSIM, or verification-code cards if the fix needs another phrase.
